# Run book: Open and preview a template

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/preview-a-template.md) | [Spec](../specs/preview-a-template.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)

## Purpose

Try a Handlebars template against JSON data and see the output at once, before wiring it into code.

## Preconditions

- The example Templates folder holds the sample templates.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Open and preview a template"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/content/templates`:

1. **Open a template file.** The list shows every template file; choosing one loads its text into the source box. Expect: The source box holds the template text.
2. **Preview the draft.** Preview renders the text in the box with the JSON data. Nothing is saved. Expect: The output shows the rendered text.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Preview shows a template error | The draft text is not valid for the engine | Fix the braces or the helper name shown in the message |
| The file list is empty | The template folder does not exist or holds no template files | Check the file template path option |

Related framework features: OoBDev.System (`ITemplateEngine`, `FileTemplateSource`); OoBDev.Handlebars.
